definitions.local_C_or_CE: Per-geometry-miss GT existence of at least one same-label query after GT-assisted component replacement.
definitions.fixed: Use the original best-IoU same-label query.
definitions.highest_score: Use the original highest-score same-label query visible to the raw mouth.
definitions.winner_switch: Fraction of all geometry-miss GT that are locally rescued by a counterfactual best query different from the original best-IoU same-label query.
definitions.matching: Per-image maximum bipartite matching between all GT and Q600 same-label query edges; baseline edges for non-geometry GT and C/CE edges for geometry-miss GT.

limitations: GT-assisted edge-specific replacements are oracle operations, not one deployable set of boxes.
Matching enforces one query per GT but does not preserve score order or AP.
No candidate-count randomized subsampling, shuffled-GT placebo, bootstrap, equivalent-angle enumeration, or Hungarian-assigned-query control.
